VI.description: PURPOSE\0AConverts the eDyno simulator state into the 58 signal values of eDyno_NVH_PoC.dbc (v0.5) for an NI-XNET Signal Output Single-point session. Called once per CAN loop iteration.\0A\0AHOW TO USE\0A1) Call it once before the loop and wire Signal List into XNET Create Session (Generic)\2C mode Signal Output Single-point. Signal List is the single source of truth for the order of Signal Values.\0A2) In the loop\2C wire Signal Values into XNET Write (Signal Single-point).\0A\0AINPUTS\0A- Fault Injection\2C Speed Profile\2C Sim Config\2C Fault Frequencies (Hz)\3A the simulator clusters\2C copied straight into the matching CAN signals.\0A- Status\3A Speed Act (rpm) = shaft speed; Torque (Nm) = motor load torque (drives the MCU model); Block Counter = AO block index; Alive Counter = CAN loop iteration. Test Step and Seq State are no longer sent.\0A\0ADERIVED SIGNALS (one comment each on the block diagram)\0A- Mode\3A 2 = run-up\2C 1 = constant speed.\0A- AtSpeed\3A 1 when |Speed Act - target| < 1 rpm (target = Run-up End or Constant Speed).\0A- ON flags\3A boolean -> 1/0.\0A- ActiveId\3A 0 = none\2C 1..5 = the single fault that is on (Imbalance\2C Misalignment\2C BPFO\2C Torque ripple\2C PWM)\2C 6 = more than one.\0A- Alive counters\3A Alive Counter mod 16.\0A- MCU_Status\3A computed by eDyno MCU Model.vi from speed and load torque.\0A\0ACHANGING THE DATABASE\0AEvery DBC change must be mirrored here (signal list + values\2C same order). Check with src/CAN/_aixml/XNET Signal Probe.vi. FlexLogger 2026 Q3 does not decode DBCs with VAL_ value tables.
